# NFL Daily — 2026-08-26 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/26: NFL owners approved the Seahawks' record $9.6 billion sale to the Khosla family. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2092690446178738353)
- 08/26: NFL has eliminated the Pro Bowl game; player honors remain, but alternates will no longer be recognized. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2092720752751509512)
- 08/26: NFL and NFLPA announced new discipline rules — three violations in a season across five health/safety categories (hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players, blindside blocks) triggers a one-game suspension. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2092705882198995422) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2092705697792512490)
- 08/26: NFL told clubs that any player who returns to college this season will be barred from signing with an NFL team in 2026, amid LSU's pursuit of former pros. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49733978/sources-ncaa-defectors-play-nfl-team-2026)
- 08/26: Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said Michael Penix Jr. won't play in Friday's preseason finale; Tua Tagovailoa will start. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7540767/2026/08/26/falcons-michael-penix-tua-tagovailoa-qb-preseason/) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2092659983632494964)
- 08/25: Bengals avoided disaster after a Ja'Marr Chase knee scare; the star WR sat out Wednesday's practice as a precaution. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7538740/2026/08/25/bengals-jamarr-chase-injury-scare/)
- 08/26: Commanders' signing of former Pro Bowl LT D.J. Humphries — brought in after starter Laremy Tunsil's injury — is now official. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2092588361563144617) — also [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/commanders-sign-d-j-humphries-laremy-tunsil-injury/)
- 08/26: Giants WR Calvin Austin will miss the season after tearing his ACL, per source. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49731270/source-giants-wr-calvin-austin-miss-upcoming-season)

## Transactions
- 08/25: Cardinals signed C Hjalte Froholdt to a two-year, $20 million contract extension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

## Injuries
- 08/26: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase (knee) did not participate in Wednesday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- 08/26: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (knee) won't play in Friday's preseason finale but believes he'll be ready for Week 1. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-08-26 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/26: Lamar Jackson said the Ravens are "in a great place" and feels "absolutely" ready for Week 1 despite playing no preseason snaps. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7541255/2026/08/26/ravens-lamar-jackson-offense-commanders-practice/) — also [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-feels-ready-for-season-in-new-system-trey-hendrickson-top-form-ravens-commanders-joint-practice-jakobi-lane-odell-beckham-jr-deandre-hopkins)
- 08/26: Ravens placed C Danny Pinter on injured reserve, ending his season, in a corresponding move to signing ILB Michael Barrett. [Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2092626753306992865) — also [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2092626093547069458)
- 08/26: Ravens' offense flashed in joint practice with the Commanders — Lamar Jackson hit Devontez Walker for a ~60-yard TD off play-action and connected with Rashod Bateman, Mark Andrews and Ja'Kobi Lane for TDs in red-zone 7-on-7s. [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2092645961558319360) — also [Baltimore Sun](https://www.baltimoresun.com/2026/08/26/lamar-jackson-ravens-offense-flashes-but-uneven-against-commanders/)
